To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the electron-positon plasma is created from the vacuum due to a strong electromagnetic field.
the electron-positrons pairs created from a vacuum by a strong laser field can be considered as a plasma with a nonperturbatively large number density.
the e-e+ plasma created from the vacuum is characterized by a nonperturbatively large density of quasiparticles, and that this plasma can be observed in the experiment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of the properties of the electron- positron quasiparticle plasma in the domain of strong fields and short wavelengths.
the properties of the electron- positron plasma created from the vacuum and the possibility to observe the vacuum creation of electron-positron quasiparticles.
a nonperturbatively calculated electron-positron pair plasma created in a vacuum from the laser field.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Schwinger mechanism is a universal mechanism of the e-e- pair creation in a strong electromagnetic field and can be used for the generation of a dense electron-positron quasiparticle plasma.
a laser field with a sufficiently high amplitude and a sufficiently short wavelength, can be used for the production of an electron-positron quasiparticle plasma from the vacuum.

the vacuum creation of e-e+ pairs can be observed in the domain of the laser parameters \lambda \lessimg \lambda_{acc}\approx 0.1\,m^{-1}\approx 1 \, \lambda_0 and E_0\lesssim E_{acc} \approx 0.3 m^2/e\approx 1.5\,E_0, which is a very narrow domain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Schwinger mechanism of the vacuum creation of e-e+ pairs due to the strong electromagnetic field is not only a theoretical prediction but a real phenomenon.
a strong laser field can be used for the generation of the electron- positron plasma from the vacuum.

, for the first time in the literature, the electron-positon plasma is described on a nonpertubative basis for a wide range of parameters of a strong laser field, i.e., in the domain where the field strengths are of the order of the Schwinger critical value and wavelengths are in a wide range from the optical to the x-ray domain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dynamical Schwing effect is possible in a wide domain of the laser radiation parameter space, including the domain of moderately strong electric fields and short laser radiation wavelengths.
the dynamical Schwingr effect in the electron-positrons plasma created from a vaccum can be observed in the experiment with a high intensity laser pulse of a moderate amplitude and short wavelength.
in the strong-field regime, the e-e+ quasinormal modes of the plasma can be excited, which are the analog of the normal plasma waves in the long-wavelength limit.
